requirement: Menu photos rank by how strongly the source says menu and drop pixels and logos; a menu price keeps its printed number with the scale the menu states in any currency; a ScrapeCreators no-results answer is not a provider error and transient search failures are retried; past the photos a source labels as a menu, reading stops after 4 not-menus in a row (stopped-early), and a pressed button reads the next batch

oracle.ref: PR #1692 (fix); fix evidence: Stand 24/10/2026: Fern Hollow 53 candidates, 13 of 24 reads went to posts that mention a menu and a 1x1 pixel (all not-menu); Iron Fence Saigon read 110 and 1485 for a VND menu printing thousands; Iron Fence instagram-search and Reverb facebook-search failed provider_error because ScrapeCreators answers no results with HTTP 404 (reproduced live, credits_charged 0). Dev 24/10/2026 (Kirami Sushi Bar, job 7036a8f9): the phone query asked with region AE answered 404 no results, so each network stopped after one counted query.
oracle.invariant: S1: order google, titled, page, story, square, post; the 1x1 named pixel and the logo are not candidates; a portrait social post is not page-shaped. S2: price stays the printed number; priceScale is 1, 1000, 10000 or 1000000 only as the menu states it, null when unsure, never inferred from the currency; glass and bottle are two items of one dish each with its size; 110 with scale 1000 equals 110.000 printed in full; displays show 110K / 1.485M, the site writes 110,000; prompts name no currency. S3: a 404 not_found is an empty answer marked charged false and the next query runs; transient failures are asked once more (a rate limit after a pause) then fall to the next provider or query; quota and a bad key stop the network with their reason; a not-charged search settles at 0 cents. S4: labeled photos are always read; past them 4 not-menus in a row stop the reading and the rest are stopped-early, not over-limit; only a menu reading resets the streak; an automatic run keeps the stop, a pressed button reads the next batch of up to 4 and its preview counts them; a result a client does not know reads as not read yet. A phone search with no result (ScrapeCreators 404) still lets the site: query run.
